questions.prompt: You mount the loop plugin (inject: llm, tools) before any adapter. What happens?
options: The loop starts and fails on its first request
The kernel throws an error at mount time
The loop's fiber stays pending until llm and tools both exist
The loop starts with a default adapter
questions.explanation: The fiber is not ready while a name in inject is missing, so refresh never starts it. It loads when the adapter's provide call adds llm.

questions.prompt: The DeepSeek adapter is disposed while the loop is active. What does the loop do?
options: It keeps running with the old adapter
It unloads, its own agent service leaves, and its fiber goes back to pending
It is disposed and can never start again
It switches to the next adapter in mount order
questions.explanation: Removing llm refreshes every fiber. The loop is no longer ready, so it runs its disposers and waits in pending until some plugin provides llm again.

questions.prompt: In dsh, why does a provider wait for its dependents to unload before running its own disposers?
options: So dependents can still use the service during their own teardown
So the provider can restart faster
So the dependents load in alphabetical order
So the service can change its name
questions.explanation: Cordis keeps the provider's effects until every dependent has unloaded, so a dependent's disposer can still call the service it used.
